**Login** — `frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`, `AuthService.login(username)` (line 16): no password/server auth at all. It looks up `localStorage` key `ai_dnd_user_<lowercase username>`; if found, that `UserProfile` becomes the active profile, else it creates a fresh empty one. The active profile is also mirrored under key `ai_dnd_user` (restored on page reload via `loadProfile()`). `logout()` just clears the active-profile signal and removes `ai_dnd_user`, but leaves the per-user `ai_dnd_user_<name>` copy intact.

**Campaigns storage** — Campaign slots (`CampaignSlot[]`) live inside that same `UserProfile` object in `localStorage`, under `profile.campaigns`, managed by `addCampaign()`/`updateCampaign()`/`removeCampaign()` (lines 36, 44, 54), each followed by `persist()` writing both storage keys. A slot just points at a Worker session/character (via `location`, set once at creation and never updated) — the actual game state (character, session) lives server-side in Cloudflare D1/KV, not in the browser.

**Deleting a campaign slot** — `removeCampaign(slotId)` only filters that slot out of the local `campaigns` array and re-persists the profile. It does **not** call the Worker API or delete anything server-side: the character row in D1 and any session data in Workers KV remain exactly as they were — just orphaned, since nothing in `localStorage` references them anymore.
